paper_proposition3_3_feasible_sequence_c.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
paper_proposition3_3_feasible_sequence_c.tex_statement: Given a finite family of fixed-length win/loss sequences over n rounds, a finite set of election winners, and a function assigning a candidate to each winning position of each sequence, if every sequence in the family has at least one winning position, every assigned round winner at a winning position belongs to the election-winner set, the assignment is injective on the winning positions of each sequence, and the election-winner set has size at most k, then the number of feasible sequences is at most the sum from wins = 1 to k of binom(n, wins).

paper_theorem3_1_from_algorithm3_generat.tex_statement: For a target RCV structure whose final-order candidates are initially active, candidate-indexed allocated voters contained in the voter set define an exact-fill ballot profile. The induced Algorithm 3 exact-fill data make that profile a minimizer of the addition problem and the smart-allocation slack-reduction operation count is at most uniqueBallotCount times candidateCount.

paper_proposition3_3_sequence_win_count_.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
paper_proposition3_3_sequence_win_count_.tex_statement: If a paper RCV sequence has win count equal to the cardinality of a round-winner set and that set is contained in the top k candidates of the final order, then the sequence satisfies the feasible-sequence win-count bound for k.

paper_proposition3_3_feasible_sequence_c.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
paper_proposition3_3_feasible_sequence_c.tex_statement: For fixed-length sequences over n rounds, if each feasible sequence has at least one win position, every win position is assigned a winner among the top k candidates of the final order, and this assignment is injective on win positions within each sequence, then the number of feasible sequences is at most the sum over wins from 1 to k of binomial(n, wins).

paper_proposition5_3_coalition_not_all_b.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
paper_proposition5_3_coalition_not_all_b.tex_statement: For a nonempty coalition contained in the candidate set, if every voter preserves a prefix through some coalition gate candidate, then along the canonical profile group-elimination generated trace it is not the case that every coalition candidate benefits from the strategic action.

paper_proposition5_5_uncertainty_coaliti.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
paper_proposition5_5_uncertainty_coaliti.tex_statement: For every uncertainty state, if the coalition is nonempty, is contained in that state's candidates, and every voter preserves a prefix through some coalition gate candidate, then ex-post all-coalition benefit is impossible along the statewise canonical group-elimination traces, while there exists an ex-ante benefit predicate under which every coalition candidate can ex-ante benefit.

paper_proposition5_6_selfish_beneficial_.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
paper_proposition5_6_selfish_beneficial_.tex_statement: If each state has a before-exit round where the candidate is active, old voters are included in the after profile with unchanged ballots, a new voter in every state casts the singleton ballot for the candidate, and some state-round eliminates before the beneficiary by a margin smaller than added votes, then selfish singleton first-place additions are always ex-post beneficial while the early-elimination margin condition may be ex-post disadvantageous.

paper_theorem3_1_from_algorithm3_generat.comment: Context-free Lean-to-TeX/prose translation for the current PaperInterface row, generated from the Lean statement only.
